system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

The winds recognize you and your bloodline, giving you and your clansmen aid. You are able to call upon it as it aids you in combat. Thanks to this unique relationship with the winds, you can utilize your clans unique fighting style known as the Divine Wind fighting stance.

You can enter the Divine Wind chakra stance as a bonus action. When you do, you have access to two different forms within this stance. You can swap between these variants at the beginning of each of your tuns at no action cost. While in either variant stance, you float gently 1 feet off the ground and you cannot take falling damage if you fall no more than 50 feet.

Pressure Front. You compress air into invisible cyclones that spiral under you, shifting pressure around you, weaponizing air pressure as you gain the following benefits;

Each time you cast a jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you build 1 High Pressure. You can spend High Pressure on effects that call for it. You can retain up to 4 High Pressure at a time, and they last for 1 minute. This increases to 6 at 11th level. You cannot gain High Pressure as part of the same action used to spend it.

You can spend 1 High Pressure as part of casting a jutsu with the Wind release keyword to grant it the Swirl effect.

Your Hijutsu gain the Critical Success/Failure effects listed.

Razor Jet. You push wind though a small pin sized funnel of chakra that you maintain, creating highly lethal jets of slicing wind that can be as devastating or surgical as you desire. You gain the following benefits;

Each time you cast a jutsu with the Wind release keyword, you apply Low Pressure to one of the affected creatures. You can spend Low Pressure an affected creature has on them on effects that call for it and they last for 1 minute.

When you deal damage to a creature with Low Pressure, you can spend it to push them 10 feet into a direction of your choice, excluding vertically.

Jutsu you cast with the Wind Release keyword, that affect an area, can have its shape changed to either a Jet Needle or Cleave:

| #### Art Link / Pinterest Link |

Jet Needle. 5-foot wide, 30-foot-long line. Creatures in this affected area suffer a -2 penalty to their saving throws. Increase the length of the line by +30 feet at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.

Cleave. Select two points you can see within 60 feet of you. Draw a line between these two points. All creatures within 5 feet of this line make their saving throw against the jutsu’s effects. On a failure, they gain +1 rank of Bleed.
